candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Base text and bolding are accurate, correct ❶❷ symbols, and both real furigana (うわさ, さか) captured. However, it invents furigana readings for nearly every kanji word (昔, 若い, 女性, 男性, 行儀, 白い目, etc.) that are not in the image — significant hallucination.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Spurious spaces inserted ('うもの なら' throughout), incorrect bold spans ('つこう**もの なら**', '**しよう**もの なら'), exercise bullets rendered as ①② instead of ❶❷, added furigana 叱(しか) not visible in image, and missed the 逆(さか) furigana.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Faithful transcription: correct text, ❶❷ symbols, and only the two furigana actually present (うわさ, さか). Main flaw: the bold emphasis on ようものなら/うものなら in the example box is not reproduced.

rationale: C is the most faithful: correct characters, correct bullet symbols, and it transcribes exactly the furigana present in the image without inventing anything; its only weakness is omitted bold emphasis. A gets the text and formatting largely right (including bold and ❶❷) but hallucinates furigana readings for almost every word, adding a large amount of content not in the image. B is worst: it introduces artificial spaces splitting うものなら, misplaces bold spans, uses wrong bullet numbering, adds furigana for 叱 that isn't in the image, and omits the 逆(さか) furigana that is.
